Self-Hosted High-Speed IoT Telemetry

Next-Generation IoT Engine
Zero Limits. Real-Time. Everywhere.

The open-source alternative to ThingSpeak. Native MQTT ingestion, continuous TimescaleDB aggregations, automatic schema discovery, and a reactive Flutter dashboard across Web, Android, and Linux.

Launch Web Dashboard → FastAPI Interactive API
⚡

Zero Artificial Rate Limits

No 15-second free tier delays. Stream high-frequency telemetry at 50Hz–100Hz continuously with sub-millisecond response times.

📊

Dynamic JSON Fields

No rigid 8-field constraints. Publish arbitrary JSON payloads; keys, units, and widgets are auto-discovered on the fly.

🔒

Edge Isolation & Mosquitto ACL

Granular device-level permissions with Go-Auth and ephemeral tokens. Raw database and MQTT ports never leave the internal bridge network.

📈

TimescaleDB Rollups

Powered by PostgreSQL hypertables with automatic 1-minute and 1-hour continuous aggregate rollups for instantaneous historical queries.
